| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | Rail sections (SearchField, FilterChip groups, SelectField, Checkbox group) in order. |

| `onRemove` * | `(id: string) => void` | Remove one active filter. |
| `onClear` * | `() => void` | Clear every filter. |
| `resultCount` * | `number` | Live result count for the sheet's "Show n tracks" button. |
